phrase.zh: 让人写的指令，更容易交给机器。
phrase.en: Make human instructions easier to give a machine.

visual.zh: 风格化人物与大型计算装置相对，卷曲纸带从两者之间穿过，象征程序翻译。机器外形和屏幕内容并非历史设备的精确还原。
visual.en: A stylized figure faces a large computer while paper loops between them, suggesting program translation. The machine and display are not exact reconstructions of historical hardware.

background.zh: 计算机历史博物馆记载，格蕾丝·霍珀在 1952 年完成用于 UNIVAC I 的 A-0，它具备后来编译器的一些特征。编译工具帮助把更接近人的写法转换成计算机可以执行的操作。
background.en: The Computer History Museum records Grace Hopper completing A-0 for the UNIVAC I in 1952; it had several features of later compilers. Such tools help translate a more human-oriented way of writing into operations a computer can execute.
